prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: authored 2D game sprite animation sheet. Reference identity: cute dark CHARCOAL OIL SLIME mound with olive-gold glossy marbled swirl bands, rounded pooled base with connected lobes, ONE prominent curled oil crest at top, exactly TWO amber-yellow glowing eyes contained inside dark socket outlines with small brown pupils, fierce brows and small jagged glowing mouth. No arms/legs/feet. Preserve rich dark opaque body, olive-gold highlights and painterly clean outline, same front three-quarter camera/facing;never mirror face/swirl arrangement. Omit ALL detached floating oil droplets from reference; ONE connected creature only, no external puddle trail (runtime draws trail). EXACTLY FOUR complete distinct whole blobs in strict equal TWO rows TWO columns, each centered at same body size and same base line, occupies at most50%cell width/height; generous EMPTY transparent center gutters/margins. Real transparent alpha outside silhouette, do NOT make dark oil body transparent; no background/haze/groundshadow/text/grid/arrows/particles/extra blobs. Genuine changing body lobes/crest/face poses, not still-image zooming. Mouth may remain gently glowing. Base stays planted.
